description: A bare `prose run` is never forwarded to the language or the hosted path: it exits 2 and suggests `cli run submit --help`, the hosted way to run a program.

problem.action: Use `cli run submit`: `prose --output json cli run submit --help`.

details.reason: `run` alone runs nothing here: hosted runs are `prose cli run submit FILE`; did you mean `prose --output json cli run submit --help`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
